tasks.title: Capture behavior baseline
tasks.goal: Record current externally observable behavior and existing failures before structural changes.
acceptance: Critical behavior is represented by tests or repeatable runtime evidence.
Known pre-existing failures are separated from new regressions.
verification: Run baseline suite/recipe and preserve evidence.

tasks.title: Define target architecture
tasks.goal: Specify desired boundaries, dependency direction, migration sequence and deletion/compatibility policy.
acceptance: Target boundaries and invariants are explicit.
Migration is staged and reversible or has a forward-fix plan.
verification: Run architecture lint/design review where available.

tasks.title: Strengthen characterization coverage
tasks.goal: Add tests or verification around behavior that must remain unchanged.
acceptance: Critical behavior is protected before movement.

tasks.title: Perform staged structural change
tasks.goal: Move code toward target boundaries while preserving scoped behavior.
acceptance: Public behavior remains unchanged unless explicitly scoped.
Dead legacy paths are removed when safe.
verification: Inspect dependency changes and migration state.

tasks.title: Run structural and deterministic checks
tasks.goal: Run tests, type/lint gates and architecture rules after refactor.

tasks.title: Compare real behavior to baseline
tasks.goal: Replay representative runtime paths and compare against pre-refactor evidence.
acceptance: Any intended behavior change is separately documented and verified.
verification: Run the same baseline recipe and compare artifacts.

tasks.title: Review target architecture attainment
tasks.goal: Check for hidden coupling, compatibility residue and boundary violations.
acceptance: No known caller remains on unintentionally deprecated paths.
verification: Review dependency graph, changed interfaces and migration state.

tasks.title: Finalize refactor
tasks.goal: Resolve findings and package verified structural change.
acceptance: Target invariants and preserved behavior both have evidence.
verification: Produce final evidence and residual-risk note.
